en: Multi-view sepia postcard showing several street and town scenes from Schafstädt in the Merseburg district. The central caption reads "Schafstädt (Kreis Merseburg)". Around it are five small photographs with German captions: a riverside or canal scene titled "Merseburger Straße", a busy street with people and houses titled "Adler-Apotheke", an open square with buildings and a monument titled "Marktplatz", another waterside view with trees and houses, and a street with larger houses and a gate-like building titled "Bahnhofstraße".
